first_pass.method: 依read_rows段号逐段阅读全文，分别扫描外层表达动作和内部词块；人工列候选，不使用预设regex发现。

second_pass.description: 回看未选段（包括致谢、政治说明、听众打断、数字段），并复查已选句外层骨架／内部词块；已读长段未选部分不凭词简单或课本出现排除。

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 假设与现实不同；本句自嘲。
items.quote: Good evening. If I were smart, I'd go home now.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 强调意义，不是普通否定。
items.quote: And yes, my purpose tonight is to wake up the Congress and alert the American people that this is no ordinary moment either.

items.chunk: What makes sth. ... is that 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 外层解释骨架。
items.quote: What makes our moment rare is that freedom and democracy are under attack at—both at home and overseas at the very same time.

items.meaning: 我向你保证／可以明确告诉你……
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: If anybody in this room thinks Putin will stop at Ukraine, I assure you: He will not.

items.chunk: be determined to keep it that way
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: that way指前句状态。
items.quote: But Ukraine—[applause]. Ukraine can stop Putin. Ukraine can stop Putin if we stand with Ukraine and provide the weapons that it needs to defend itself. That is all—that is all—Ukraine is asking. They're not asking for American soldiers. In fact, there are no American soldiers at war in Ukraine, and I'm determined to keep it that way.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 负面评价，不是默认礼貌服从。
items.quote: The President. That's a quote. A former President actually said that, bowing down to a Russian leader. I think it's outrageous, it's dangerous, and it's unacceptable.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: America is a founding member of NATO, the military alliance of democratic nations created after World War II prevent—to prevent war and keep the peace.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: I say this to Congress: We have to stand up to Putin. Send me a bipartisan national security bill. History is literally watching. History is watching. If the United States walks away, it will put Ukraine at risk. Europe is at risk. The free world will be at risk, emboldening others to do what they wish to do us harm.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Many of you were here on that darkest of days. We all saw with our own eyes, the insurrectionists were not patriots. They had come to stop the peaceful transfer of power, to overturn the will of the people.

items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 正式；本句不论党派。
items.quote: As I've done ever since being elected to office, I ask all of you, without regard to party, to join together and defend democracy.

items.meaning: 某事本来绝不应该发生
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 对过去事件的评判。
items.quote: What her family had gone through should never have happened.

items.chunk: Unless 从句, it could happen again
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 提出防止复发的条件。
items.quote: Unless Congress acts, it could happen again.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Like most Americans, I believe Roe v. Wade got it right.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 负面语气。
items.quote: My predecessor came to office determined to see Roe v. Wade overturned. He's the reason it was overturned, and he brags about it. Look at the chaos that has resulted.

items.meaning: 恕我直言／容我表示不同意见
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 往往后接反对，未必减弱冒犯。
items.quote: Wade, the Supreme Court majority wrote the following—and with all due respect, Justices—"Women are not without electoral power"— excuse me—"electoral or political power." You're about to realize just how much you were right about that.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语，原句带批评。
items.quote: Wade have no clue about the power of women.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: So let's tell the story here—tell it here and now.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 未说on the brink of什么，需语境补足。
items.quote: Folks, I inherited an economy that was on the brink.

items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 演讲夸张评价，不当可核实事实。
items.quote: Now, our economy is literally the envy of the world: 15 million new jobs in just 3 years—a record, a record; unemployment at 50-year lows.

items.chunk: Where is it written (that) 从句?
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 反驳所谓不可突破的限制，修辞问句。
items.quote: Americans. Eight hundred thousand new manufacturing jobs in America and counting. Where is it written we can't be the manufacturing capital of the world? We are, and we will.

items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 比较评价骨架，不当演讲事实证明。
items.quote: More people have health insurance today than ever before.

items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 正式法律／政策语域。
items.quote: "Buy America" has been the law of the land since the 1930s.

items.chunk: drive up the price of sth.
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: And thanks to our CHIPS and Science Act, the United States is investing more in research and development than ever before. During the pandemic, a shortage of semiconductors, chips that drove up the price of everything from cell phones to automobiles—and by the way, we invented those chips right here in America.

items.meaning: 为某人／某事加油、表示支持
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: And by the way, I noticed some of you who've strongly voted against it are there cheering on that money coming in. [Laughter] And I like it. I'm with you. I'm with you. And if any of you don't want that money in your district, just let me know. [Laughter]

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 本句面对对手带调侃；并非地理位置。
items.quote: [Laughter] And I like it. I'm with you.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 安排沟通的套语。
items.quote: And if any of you don't want that money in your district, just let me know.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Because of my investment in family farms—[applause]—because I invested in family farms—led by my Secretary of Agriculture, who knows more about this than anybody I know— we're better able to stay in the family for the—those farms so their—and their children and grandchildren won't have to leave home to make a living.

items.chunk: be on one's way to doing sth.
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 这里即将关闭，不是人在路上。
items.quote: The great comeback story is Belvidere, Illinois. Home to an auto plant for nearly 60 years. Before I came to office, the plant was on its way to shutting down. Thousands of workers feared for their livelihoods. Hope was fading.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Then, I was elected to office, and we raised the Belvidere repeatedly with auto companies, knowing unions would make all the difference.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 复合形容词，可修饰设备或系统，不当单个生词丢弃。
items.quote: Instead of auto factories shutting down, auto factories are reopening, and a new state-of-the- art battery factory is being built to power those cars there at the same—[applause]. Folks— [applause]. To the folks of Belvidere, I say: Instead of your town being left behind, your community is moving forward again. Because instead of watching auto jobs of the future go overseas, 4,000 union jobs with higher wages are building a future in Belvidere right here in America.

items.meaning: 被落下、被时代发展抛在后面
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Instead of auto factories shutting down, auto factories are reopening, and a new state-of-the- art battery factory is being built to power those cars there at the same—[applause]. Folks— [applause]. To the folks of Belvidere, I say: Instead of your town being left behind, your community is moving forward again. Because instead of watching auto jobs of the future go overseas, 4,000 union jobs with higher wages are building a future in Belvidere right here in America.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 财务搭配。
items.quote: The President. Tonight—tonight, I want to talk about the future of possibilities that we can build together, a future where the days of trickle-down economics are over and the wealthy and the biggest corporations no longer get the—all the tax breaks.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: That's why I determined to turn things around so the middle class does well.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 评价目前进展仍不足。
items.quote: And there's more to do to make sure you're feeling the benefits of all we're doing.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: healthy并非身体健康。
items.quote: Instead of paying $400 a month or thereabouts for insulin with diabetes—and it only costs 10 bucks to make—they only get paid $35 a month now and still make a healthy profit.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 补在估计数字后。
items.quote: Instead of paying $400 a month or thereabouts for insulin with diabetes—and it only costs 10 bucks to make—they only get paid $35 a month now and still make a healthy profit.

items.chunk: cap the cost of sth. at ...
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 政策和预算讨论。
items.quote: And I want to—and what to do next, I want to cap the cost of insulin at $35 a month for every American who needs it—everyone.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: This year, Medicare is negotiating lower prices for some of the costliest drugs on the market that treat everything from heart disease to arthritis.

items.chunk: get in trouble for doing sth.
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Folks, I'm going to get in trouble for saying that, but any of you want to get in Air Force One with me and fly to Toronto, Berlin, Moscow—I mean, excuse me.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语；deal此处非交易。
items.quote: Folks, the Affordable Care Act—the old "Obamacare"—is still a very big deal.

items.chunk: I'm not going to let that happen
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 坚定阻止；that须有前文。
items.quote: The President. I'm not going to let that happen.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: But I'm not waiting. I want to provide an annual tax credit that will give Americans $400 a month for the next 2 years as mortgage rates come down to put toward their mortgages when they buy their first home or trade up for a little more space. Just for 2 years.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: I want to provide an annual tax credit that will give Americans $400 a month for the next 2 years as mortgage rates come down to put toward their mortgages when they buy their first home or trade up for a little more space.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: When you refinance your home, you can save $1,000 or more as a consequence.

items.meaning: 严厉打击／整治某种行为
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: For millions of renters, we're cracking down on big landlords who use antitrust law—using antitrust—who break antitrust laws—by price-fixing and driving up rents. We've cut redtape so builders can get federally financing, which is already helping build a record 1.7 million new house—housing units nationwide.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 原件redtape合写照录；正常教学核验red tape。
items.quote: We've cut redtape so builders can get federally financing, which is already helping build a record 1.7 million new house—housing units nationwide.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: And I, like I suspect all of you, want to give a child—every child a good start by providing access to preschool for 3- and 4-years-old.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: You know, I think I pointed out last year—[applause]. I think I pointed out last year that children coming from broken homes where there's no books, they're not read to, not spoken to very often start school—kindergarten or first grade hearing—having heard a million fewer words spoken.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 不同于继续做同一件事。
items.quote: Well, studies show that children who go to preschool are nearly 50-percent more likely to finish high school and go on to earn a 2- and 4-year degree no matter what their background is.

items.chunk: Don't hold me to the exact number
items.meaning: 别要求我对这个确切数字打包票
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 说明数字为记忆中的估计。
items.quote: I pointed out to them: As Vice President, I met with over eight—I think it was 182 of those folks—don't hold me to the exact number—and I asked them what they need most—the CEOs.

items.chunk: on both sides of the aisle
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 原指议会两党，职场使用需语境明确。
items.quote: And you've had the same experience on both sides of the aisle.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: I want to expand high-quality tutoring and summer learning to see that every child learns to read by third grade. I'm also connecting local businesses and high schools so students get hands- on experience and a path to a good-paying job whether or not they go to college.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: I'm also connecting local businesses and high schools so students get hands- on experience and a path to a good-paying job whether or not they go to college.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: When I was told I couldn't universally just change the way in which we did—dealt with student loans, I fixed two student loan programs that already existed to reduce the burden of student debt for nearly 4 million Americans, including nurses, firefighters, and others in public service.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 通常指开始育儿，不自动等于结婚。
items.quote: And, folks, look, such relief is good for the economy because folks are now able to buy a home, start a business, start a family.

items.meaning: 既然已经在做这事，就顺便……
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 引入相关追加事项。
items.quote: And while we're at it, I want to give public school teachers a raise.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: And while we're at it, I want to give public school teachers a raise. And by the way, the first couple of years, we cut the deficit.

items.chunk: speak to the question of sth.
items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 正式；speak to非对物说话。
items.quote: Now let me speak to the question of fundamental fairness for all Americans.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 原句为纳税，也可用于共同费用。
items.quote: Just pay your fair share in taxes.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语引入要点，非总指交易。
items.quote: But here's the deal.

items.meaning: 看看数据／把数核对一下
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 用证据核实判断的指令。
items.quote: They added more to the national debt than any Presidential term in American history. Check the numbers.

items.chunk: fight like hell to do sth.
items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语强烈，hell不宜正式温和沟通。
items.quote: The President. I sure don't. I'm going to keep fighting like hell to make it fair. Under my plan, nobody earning less than $400,000 a year will pay an additional penny in Federal taxes— nobody—not one penny. And they haven't yet.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: In fact, the child tax credit I passed during the pandemic cut taxes for millions of working families and cut child poverty in half. Restore that child tax credit. No child should go hungry in this country.

items.chunk: No one should have to choose between A and B
items.meaning: 不该让任何人被迫在A与B之间选择
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 规范立场，比don't have to更强调不应制造困境。
items.quote: Imagine a future with paid leave, because no one should have to choose between working and taking care of their sick family member.

items.meaning: 面临被削减／取消的危险
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 比喻；原文为社保。
items.quote: Many of my friends on the other side of the aisle want to put Social Security on the chopping block.

items.chunk: I kind of thought 从句
items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语缓和断言，也可含讽刺。
items.quote: The President. I kind of thought that's what your plan was.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 接收消息的回应；原场景含调侃。
items.quote: [Laughter] Well, that's good to hear.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 负面评价，勿用于中性利润增长。
items.quote: The President. ——too many corporations raise prices to pad their profits, charging more and more for less and less. That's why we're cracking down on corporations that engage in price gouging and deceptive pricing, from food to health care to housing.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语粗俗加强语。
items.quote: In fact, the snack companies think you won't notice if they change the size of the bag and put a hell of a lot fewer—[laughter]—same size bag—put fewer chips in it.

items.meaning: 在某人不知情的情况下

vocabulary_candidates.quote: Americans pay more for prescription drugs than anywhere in the world. It's wrong, and I'm ending it. With a law that I proposed and signed—and not one of your Republican buddies work—voted for it—we finally beat Big Pharma. Instead of paying $400 a month or thereabouts for insulin with diabetes—and it only costs 10 bucks to make—they only get paid $35 a month now and still make a healthy profit.

For millions of renters, we're cracking down on big landlords who use antitrust law—using antitrust—who break antitrust laws—by price-fixing and driving up rents. We've cut redtape so builders can get federally financing, which is already helping build a record 1.7 million new house—housing units nationwide.

The President. ——too many corporations raise prices to pad their profits, charging more and more for less and less. That's why we're cracking down on corporations that engage in price gouging and deceptive pricing, from food to health care to housing.

In fact, the snack companies think you won't notice if they change the size of the bag and put a hell of a lot fewer—[laughter]—same size bag—put fewer chips in it. No, I'm not joking. It's called "shrink-flation." Pass Bobby Casey's bill, and stop this. I really mean it.

You know, as we manage challenges at home, we're also managing crises abroad, including in the Middle East. I know the last 5 months have been gut-wrenching for so many people: for the Israeli people, for the Palestinian people, and so many here in America.

Creating stability in the Middle East also means containing the threat posed by Iran. That's why I built a coalition of more than a dozen countries to defend international shipping and freedom of navigation in the Red Sea.
